request.text: Find me a new Samsung Odyssey G5 G55C 27-inch curved 165 Hz monitor for delivery to Tripoli.

message:
Abed Tahan lists the matching 27-inch curved 165 Hz monitor (SKU LS27CG552EM) at $239.00, available online.
However, the listing does not explicitly confirm new condition, and I could not verify delivery to Tripoli or its fee.
Treat this as a candidate rather than a fully confirmed match: confirm it is brand new and check Tripoli delivery terms on the shop’s site before ordering.

product.title: Samsung 32CG55 32" 2K QHD 165Hz Odyssey G5 Curved
product.description:
The Samsung 32CG55 32" 2K QHD 165Hz Odyssey G5 Curved is a 32" gaming monitor with a 1000R curved VA panel at 2,560 x 1,440. It runs up to 165Hz with a 1 ms (MPRT) response time, supports FreeSync and HDR10, and has a 2,500:1 static contrast ratio.
It suits gamers who want a large, sharp screen that fills their view, especially for shooters, racing and open-world games where the high refresh rate and tight curve help. Browse more gaming monitors to compare, and pay cash on delivery across Lebanon.
Highlights
32" curved VA panel with 1000R curvature
2,560 x 1,440 QHD resolution, 16:9 aspect ratio
Up to 165Hz refresh rate with 1 ms (MPRT) response time
FreeSync and HDR10 support
2,500:1 static contrast and 300 cd/㎡ typical brightness
1 DisplayPort 1.2, 1 HDMI (version 2) and a headphone output
Best for
Fast competitive games such as FPS titles, using the 165Hz refresh rate and Low Input Lag Mode
Immersive racing, RPG and open-world games on a 32" 1000R curve
Gaming PCs with a graphics card that can push high frame rates at QHD
Long sessions, with Flicker Free and Eye Saver Mode
